newsitem.title: MEXICO: Santander raises Cemex earnings estimates.
newsitem.headline: Santander raises Cemex earnings estimates.

text.p: Santander Brokerage raised its 1996, 1997 and 1998 earnings estimates for Mexico-based cement company Cemex S.A. and reiterated its buy rating on the firm.

Analyst Carlos Perezalonso upped his year-end earnings estimate on Cemex to $1.43 per ADR from $1.29, raised his 1997 earnings per ADR to $1.41 from $1.38, and 1998 earnings to $1.47 from $1.38 per ADR.
He also set a 12- to 18-month target price of $9.60 per ADR, some 28 percent higher than current levels.
Perezalonso said Cemex, the world's fourth largest cement firm, will benefit from economic recovery in Mexico, Venezuela, and Colombia.

He also said Cemex is focusing on emerging markets with huge infrastructure requirements, has streamlines operations to become efficient and is one of the cheapest priced cement companies in the world.
Cemex's CPO shares closed at 27.45 pesos on Thursday, off 60 centavos on the day.
